title: What is Evil?
description: Evil is often thought of as an external force, something separate from us, lurking in the shadows. But in this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav offers a transformative perspective— evil is not a presence but an absence . It is the absence of love, of light, of consciousness.

Gary explains that removing evil from the world begins with removing it from within ourselves . Darkness, or fear, manifests in our frightened parts of personality—our anger, judgment, and resentment. The key to transformation is not in suppressing these emotions but in acknowledging and challenging them.
The solution to evil is not punishment or eradication but love and awareness . As Russian novelist Alexander Solzhenitsyn observed, the line between good and evil runs through every human heart.

(00:41) — The true nature of evil: an absence, not a presence (01:25) — Why eliminating darkness starts with transforming yourself (02:35) — How to challenge fear instead of acting from it (03:24) — The power of making conscious, healthy choices (05:05) — Why compassion, even for those who lack it, is an act of courage
